heading: SERVICES
text: The Supplier shall provide the services described in mutually executed statements of work. Each statement of work shall specify the scope, deliverables, milestones, fees, and applicable acceptance criteria.

heading: SERVICES
text: The Supplier shall perform the services with reasonable skill and care and in accordance with applicable law.

heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
text: The Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty days after receipt.

heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
text: If the Customer disputes an invoice in good faith, it shall notify the Supplier in writing and the parties shall cooperate to resolve the dispute.

heading: CONFIDENTIALITY
text: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public business, technical, financial, and commercial information received from the other party.

heading: CONFIDENTIALITY
text: Confidential information may be disclosed where required by law, provided that the receiving party gives prior notice where legally permitted.

heading: DATA PROTECTION
text: Each party shall comply with applicable data-protection laws when processing personal data under this Agreement.

heading: DATA PROTECTION
text: The Supplier shall implement reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or disclosure.

heading: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
text: Each party retains ownership of intellectual property owned or developed independently of this Agreement.

heading: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
text: Subject to payment of applicable fees, the Customer receives a non-exclusive license to use deliverables supplied under an applicable statement of work for its internal business purposes.

heading: WARRANTIES
text: The Supplier warrants that the services will materially conform to the applicable statement of work.

heading: WARRANTIES
text: Except as expressly stated in this Agreement, neither party makes any other warranty, whether express or implied, to the extent permitted by law.

heading: TERMINATION
text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the breaching party fails to cure the breach within thirty days after receiving written notice describing the breach.

heading: TERMINATION
text: The Supplier may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause and without providing prior notice to the Customer.

heading: TERMINATION
text: Upon termination, each party shall return or securely destroy the other party's confidential information, subject to legal retention obligations.

heading: INDEMNIFICATION
text: The Supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless the Customer against all claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses arising from the Supplier's material breach of this Agreement.

heading: INDEMNIFICATION
text: Notwithstanding any other provision, the Supplier shall be liable for all losses arising from its obligations under this Section without limitation or monetary cap.

heading: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
text: Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of this Agreement.

heading: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
text: Except for liabilities expressly excluded from the limitation, each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid or payable under the applicable statement of work during the preceding twelve months.

heading: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
text: Nothing in this Agreement limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

heading: FORCE MAJEURE
text: Neither party shall be liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided that the affected party promptly notifies the other party and uses reasonable efforts to mitigate the effects.

heading: NOTICES
text: Notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered to the addresses specified by the parties.

heading: NOTICES
text: The parties shall provide written notice of any change to their registered address within thirty days of such change.

heading: GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES
text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws specified in the applicable statement of work.

heading: GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES
text: The parties shall first attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through negotiation before commencing formal proceedings.

heading: GENERAL
text: This Agreement and its statements of work constitute the entire agreement between the parties concerning their subject matter.

heading: GENERAL
text: No amendment is effective unless made in writing and signed by authorized representatives of both parties.

heading: GENERAL
text: If any provision is held unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in effect.
